summary: Marked car park beside a rail depot; no homes, but full of cars.
reasons: Rail depot and bush surround it

best_section.where: Marked bays along the west side of the depot access road

drivers.seclusion: Rail depot sheds to the east, trees and parkland to the west; no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with marked bays off the depot road; open at the north end, no gate seen. Esri shows most bays occupied, QLD shows nearly empty.
drivers.traffic: Quiet depot road; rail noise and work traffic likely.
drivers.convention: Looks like a staff car park for the depot, so a van may be noticed in the morning.

flags: Mapped gate 237 m away, not on only access
Moolabin Creek 139 m away, ground about 10 m elevation
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees shade the west edge in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is staff-only
